canonical_rules.collision_trigger: equality of any one of the three SHA-256 signatures
canonical_rules.distinct_collision_identity: the triple of three hashes; duplicate historical copies count once
canonical_rules.eligible_conllu_rows: integer token IDs only; multiword ranges and empty nodes excluded
canonical_rules.normalized_content_bytes: UTF-8 of lowercase Python str.lower forms joined by one ASCII space after whitespace collapse
precedence: prior full-source label-dependent scoring => source ineligible
exact full-document signature => whole document removed
any collided sentence with ud_word_count >= 8 => whole document removed
at least two distinct collision identities in a document => whole document removed
otherwise the one isolated short collided sentence is removed from every model-input role
canonical_rules.selected_subtoken_sequence_bytes: canonical compact ASCII JSON array from the pinned tokenizer with is_split_into_words=True and no special tokens
canonical_rules.ud_form_sequence_bytes: canonical compact UTF-8 JSON array of original-case integer-row FORM strings
canonical_rules.ud_word_count: number of integer-ID syntactic-word rows, including punctuation
